description: BaGetter is a lightweight NuGet and symbol server.
notes: BaGetter requires the .NET SDK to run. If not yet installed:
Start the server with 'bagetter' (default: http://localhost:5000, override with 'bagetter --urls http://*:8080').
Configuration and data are kept in the persist directory ($env:SCOOP\persist\bagetter):
appsettings.Production.json database and package storage overrides
pre_install: $json = @{ Database = @{ ConnectionString = "Data Source=$($persist -replace '\\','/')/bagetter.db" }; Storage = @{ Path = "$($persist -replace '\\','/')/packages" } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
post_install: if (!(Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { warn "'dotnet' not found! Install it with 'scoop install dotnet-sdk' before running 'bagetter'." }
